caution_notes: Nur 3 Stunden sauberes Fenster am Nachmittag (15-18 Uhr) — kurzes Flugfenster.
Morgenfenster 06-08 Uhr mit kraeftiger Hoehenwind und keiner Thermik — nur Soaring möglich.
engadin_ober.wind_summary: Der Wind auf Referenzhöhe (2450m) bleibt den ganzen Tag schwach und stabil zwischen 9 und 14 km/h aus südwestlicher Richtung. Keine signifikante Zunahme im Tagesverlauf. Der Höhenwind auf 700 hPa (ca. 3100m) liegt meist unter 20 km/h, nur morgens kurz bei 21 km/h (kraeftiger Hoehenwind). Die Windverhältnisse sind unauffällig und stellen kein Sicherheitsproblem dar.

caution_notes: Rain: 5 hours of rain from 12:00 to 16:00, only 1 dry hour after.
Altitude wind: 28-34 km/h from 2000-3100m all day, WARN-level throughout.
praettigau_davos.wind_summary: Surface wind at reference height (1700m) is light, 4-10 km/h from variable directions (NW to SW). No strong wind or gusts. The wind trend is stable, no significant change during the day.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 30 km/h at 3100m around 09:00 and 17:00, but well above typical climbing band (1500-2300m).
Shear and torn degradation at 09:00: thermals may be rough and hard to center for one hour.
rheintal.wind_summary: Wind on reference height (1500m) is light and stable throughout the day: 4-16 km/h from west to northwest. No strong wind phases. The wind trend is stable with no significant increase after the window. A brief period of slightly higher altitude wind at 3100m does not affect the flying layer.

caution_notes: Wind: ab 10:00 auf 24 km/h ansteigend, WARN-Level bis 12:00, danach DANGER-Level ab 13:00.
Höhenwind: ab 12:00 über 30 km/h in Flugschicht (800 hPa), DANGER-Level bis 17:00.
Fensterlänge: nur 5 Stunden sauberes Fenster, danach zunehmend gefährliche Bedingungen.
alpstein.wind_summary: Der Wind auf Referenzhöhe (1640m) startet morgens ruhig mit 6 km/h aus Südwest und steigt bis 09:00 auf 16 km/h. Ab 10:00 erreicht er WARN-Niveau (24-30 km/h) und ab 13:00 DANGER-Niveau (32-36 km/h). Der Trend zeigt eine deutliche Zunahme: nach dem sauberen Fenster (07-12 Uhr) bleibt der Wind bis zum Abend stark. Die Richtung ist konstant südwestlich (225-257°).

caution_notes: Regen und dichte Bewölkung um 12:00: Niederschlag 0.1 mm/h, Wolkenbasis auf 2160 m MSL, Stunde unfliegbar.
Höhenmaessiger Windung ab 16:00: 32-34 km/h auf 3100-3120 m MSL, Thermik-Top liegt darunter, aber Flugbereich betroffen.
zentralschweizer_voralpen.wind_summary: Der Wind auf Referenzhöhe (1860 m) bleibt den ganzen Tag schwach und stabil aus südwestlicher Richtung, meist zwischen 7 und 13 km/h. Erst ab 16:00 nimmt der Höhenwind in der oberen Flugschicht auf Warn-Niveau zu, während der Bodenwind moderat bleibt. Der Wind-Verlauf zeigt eine leichte Zunahme am Nachmittag, aber ohne gefährliche Spitzen.

no_go_reasons: Verhaeltnis sauber/gesamt: 25% — Tag ueberwiegend gefaehrlich
Regen bis 14:00, nur 3h trockenes Fenster danach
kraeftiger Hoehenwind 8h — Hoehenwind erhoeht, Fenster eingekesselt
surselva.wind_summary: Bodenwind im Fenster schwach 9-12 km/h, Referenzwind 4-6 km/h. Wind-Verlauf stabil ohne Verschlechterung. Keine starker Wind Stunden im Fenster.

caution_notes: Rain shower at 13:00, brief interruption of flying window.
Altitude wind increases to 35-41 km/h on 700 hPa from 15:00, shear degrades thermal quality.
glarnerland_walensee.wind_summary: Surface wind at reference height (1300m) is light all day, 2-8 km/h from west-northwest. No strong wind periods. Altitude wind on 700 hPa increases from 20 km/h in the morning to 41 km/h by late afternoon, but stays below danger threshold for the flight layer. Wind trend is stable with a gradual increase aloft.

caution_notes: Regen: leichter Niederschlag 11:00-12:00, danach durchgehend trocken.
Höhenwind: 31-35 km/h auf 3100m ab 12:00, Thermik-Top bis 2500m, Wind in der Flugschicht erhöht.
berner_voralpen.wind_summary: Bodenwind auf Referenzhöhe 1800m: morgens 4-8 km/h aus Südwest, ab 12:00 auf 9-17 km/h aus West bis Nordwest zunehmend. Höhenwind auf 700 hPa (ca. 3100m) steigt von 18 auf 35 km/h aus Südwest bis West. Windfeld bleibt unter der DANGER-Schwelle, aber der Höhenwind erreicht WARN-Niveau ab Mittag.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 29-39 km/h on 700 hPa, WARN level from 08:00, DANGER at 12:00 and 17:00.
Bodenwind: 22-26 km/h from 14:00, WARN level, moderate but manageable.
Rain: isolated light rain at 09:00, clearing quickly.
Thermal quality: shear and torn degrade thermals in the morning, improving after 13:00.
freiburger_voralpen.wind_summary: Wind on reference height (1500m) is light in the morning (4-7 km/h from west), increasing to 13-26 km/h from west-northwest after 13:00. The wind trend is stable with a moderate increase, no dangerous gusts. The afternoon wind is at WARN level (20-26 km/h) but within manageable limits for experienced pilots.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 20-30 km/h in the flight layer from 07:00-15:00, increasing to 30-35 km/h after 16:00, making the afternoon sporty.
Wind on reference height: 15-20 km/h from 13:00, reaching 20 km/h at 16:00, with a maessiger Wind at 17:00.
Thermal quality degraded by shear and wind: Thermik zerrissen at 10:00, starker Grundwind stoert Thermik from 14:00-17:00, requiring experienced handling.
genferseeregion.wind_summary: Wind on reference height (800m) is light in the morning at 5-8 km/h from SW, increasing to 15-20 km/h from SW-W in the afternoon. The wind remains moderate throughout, with a brief maessiger Wind at 17:00 at 20 km/h. The trend is stable with no significant deterioration.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 20-30 km/h in the flight layer from 06:00-13:00, then 30-46 km/h from 14:00-17:00, making the afternoon unsafe.
Overcast danger: low cloud base near 1500m at 10:00-11:00, limiting climb and visibility.
Wind: 20-24 km/h on reference height from 09:00 onward, with maessiger Wind tags for 6 hours.
Only 50% of the day is clean (6 of 12 hours), with two separate windows of 4h and 2h.
jura_west.wind_summary: Wind on reference height (1200m) is moderate at 12-17 km/h in the early morning, increasing to 20-24 km/h from 09:00 onward. The wind direction is consistently from the southwest (220-260°). The Wind-Verlauf shows a stable pattern with no significant deterioration after the window, but the wind remains at WARN level (20-30 km/h) for most of the day.

no_go_reasons: Kraeftiger Hoehenwind im Flugbereich: >30 km/h in 4h
caution_notes: Altitude wind: 27-32 km/h in the flight layer (2000m) from 10:00 onward, with DANGER-level at 10:00 and 15:00-17:00.
Surface wind: 20-24 km/h from 09:00-11:00 and 15:00-17:00, WARN-level.
Wind trend: persistently elevated with 9 of 12 hours at WARN or DANGER, longest calm window only 3 hours.
jura_zentral.wind_summary: Surface wind at reference height (1280m) is light in the early morning (6-8 km/h from SW), then increases to 20-24 km/h from W/SW between 09:00-11:00 and 15:00-17:00. Midday sees a brief drop to 18-19 km/h. The wind is consistently from the SW-W quadrant, no significant directional shift. Overall, moderate to strong wind dominates the day.

caution_notes: Hoehenwind: 25-32 km/h auf 1500-2000m ab 14:00, kraeftiger Hoehenwind 13:00-15:00, gefaehrlicher Hoehenwind 16:00-17:00 (ausserhalb Fenster).
Bodenwind: 22-24 km/h aus SW ab 14:00, maessiger Wind 14:00-17:00 (ab 16:00 ausserhalb Fenster).
Thermik-Wind-Degradation: ab 15:00 Windscherung beeintraechtigt Thermikqualitaet, aber noch fliegbar.
mittelland_west.wind_summary: Der Bodenwind auf Referenzhoehe (700m) ist morgens schwach mit 3-6 km/h aus SW, steigt ab 10:00 auf 12 km/h und erreicht ab 14:00 22-24 km/h aus SW (maessiger Wind). Der Wind bleibt bis 15:00 im sportlichen Bereich, danach ausserhalb des sicheren Fensters. Der Trend ist zunehmend, aber ohne DANGER-Level im Fenster.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 28-33 km/h in the flight layer from 10:00, reaching DANGER level (32-39 km/h) from 15:00 to 17:00.
Surface wind: increases to 20-24 km/h (WARN) from 14:00 onward, making launches sporty.
Wind trend: increasing through the day, with the strongest winds after 15:00.
jura_ost.wind_summary: Surface wind at reference height (900m) is light in the morning (3-7 km/h from SW), then increases to 10-17 km/h by late morning, reaching 20-24 km/h from 14:00 onward. The wind direction remains consistently from the west-southwest (249-283°). The trend is increasing, with the strongest winds after 15:00. No dangerous surface wind speeds are forecast, but the afternoon becomes sporty.

caution_notes: Hoehenwind: 20-30 km/h auf 2000m, 8h WARN-Level, ab 15:00 auf 36-45 km/h DANGER-Level.
Regen: 09:00 leichter Regen, danach trocken.
Ueberdeckung: 11:00 dichte tiefe Wolkenbasis 1520m, danach auflockernd.
Nutzbares Fenster nur 7 von 12h sauber (58%), mehrere kurze Lücken.
schwarzsee_gantrisch.wind_summary: Bodenwind auf Referenzhoehe 1500m meist 10-20 km/h aus West bis Suedwest, durchgehend moderat. Keine Starkwindphasen am Boden. Der Wind bleibt ueber den Tag stabil, ohne signifikante Zunahme.

caution_notes: Wind: durchgehend auf WARN-Level (20-27 km/h) von 07:00-16:00, mit Spitzen 38 km/h ab 17:00.
Höhenwind: WARN-Level (21-29 km/h) im Flugbereich 09:00-16:00, DANGER-Level (36-42 km/h) ab 15:00 auf 3100m.
Trend: Wind steigt nach 16:00 auf DANGER-Niveau (38 km/h) – Fensterende beachten.
berner_oberland.wind_summary: Der Wind auf Referenzhöhe (1800m) liegt zwischen 16 und 27 km/h aus West bis Südwest. Von 07:00-16:00 dominieren WARN-Stufen (20-27 km/h), mit ruhigeren Phasen um 06:00 und 11:00 (16-17 km/h). Ab 17:00 steigt der Wind auf 38 km/h (DANGER). Der Trend zeigt eine kontinuierliche Zunahme im Tagesverlauf.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 33-36 km/h in the flight layer at 1500-2000m, 10:00-12:00 and 15:00-16:00, making those hours sporty or unflyable.
Wind trend: increasing from calm morning to strong afternoon winds, with 4 hours at DANGER level (11:00, 12:00, 15:00, 16:00).
Fragmented safe windows: three separate windows (5h, 2h, 1h) with DANGER gaps in between.
seeland_emmental.wind_summary: Morning winds are light (3-6 km/h from SW) until 09:00. From 10:00, wind increases to 9-19 km/h from the west, with reference-level wind at 600m reaching 15-19 km/h by afternoon. The wind trend shows a steady increase from calm to moderate-strong, with 4 hours at DANGER level for altitude wind. No significant directional shift.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 26-47 km/h in the flight layer from 11:00 onward, with DANGER-level (40-47 km/h) at 700 hPa from 15:00-17:00.
Surface wind: 24 km/h at 11:00 and 23 km/h at 16:00, both WARN-level.
Shear: moderate shear develops in the afternoon, degrading thermal quality at 17:00.
mittelland_zentral.wind_summary: Surface wind at reference height (1400m) is light in the morning: 5-10 km/h from 252-255° until 08:00. It increases to 15-19 km/h from 09:00-10:00, then reaches WARN-level 24 km/h at 11:00. From 12:00-15:00 it drops back to 14-18 km/h, then picks up again to 23 km/h at 16:00 and 19 km/h at 17:00. The wind direction remains consistently from the west (252-280°) throughout the day. The trend is increasing: calm morning, then moderate to strong wind in the afternoon.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 23-29 km/h in the flight layer from 11:00, reaching DANGER level (30+ km/h) from 14:00 to 17:00 — strong shear and drift above 1500m.
Bodenwind: increasing from calm morning to 19-21 km/h by afternoon, with a maessiger Wind at 15:00 (21 km/h).
zentrales_mittelland.wind_summary: Wind on reference height (600m) is calm in the morning (3-8 km/h from variable directions), then increases from 10:00 onward to 11-21 km/h from SW. The trend is increasing: a quiet start gives way to moderate wind by midday, with a peak of 21 km/h at 15:00 (maessiger Wind). No dangerous wind speeds on the ground, but the afternoon breeze is noticeable.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 27-45 km/h in the flight layer from 10:00 onward, with DANGER-level (over 30 km/h) from 12:00-14:00 and 16:00-17:00.
Wind increasing through the day: calm morning (4-8 km/h), then building to 22 km/h by 16:00 with maessiger Wind at 16:00.
Safe window fragmented: main window 06:00-12:00 (6h), then a short 1h window at 15:00-16:00, with DANGER gaps in between.
mittelland_ost.wind_summary: Morning winds are light (4-8 km/h from SW) until 09:00. From 10:00, wind increases steadily, reaching 14-19 km/h by midday and peaking at 22 km/h at 16:00 (maessiger Wind). The trend is increasing, with the strongest winds in the afternoon. Reference height wind stays mostly moderate, but the altitude wind becomes strong.

caution_notes: Altitude wind: 30-35 km/h in the flight layer from 13:00 onward, making the afternoon unsafe for flying.
Wind increasing: calm morning (5 km/h) builds to 18 km/h by afternoon, with 5 hours of DANGER-level altitude wind.
bodenseeraum.wind_summary: Morning winds are light (2-7 km/h from variable directions) until 10:00. From 11:00, wind picks up to 11-19 km/h from southwest, remaining moderate at reference height. The trend shows a gradual increase through the day, but surface wind stays below 20 km/h. No strong surface winds are forecast.
